subject: Your call yesterday
body:
Hi,

Thanks for the call yesterday. The demo looked interesting. However, we are in the middle of our year-end closing, and my team is already working overtime. Could you just send me a price list? I'll share it with our managing director when things calm down.

Best,
Laura

hidden.de: Ihr Team ist überlastet, und sie fürchtet zusätzliche Arbeit. Entscheiden wird der Geschäftsführer.
hidden.en: Her team is overloaded, and she is afraid of extra work. The managing director will decide.

must.de: Verständnis für die stressige Zeit zeigen
must.en: Show understanding for the busy period

must.de: zeigen, wie wenig Aufwand ihr Team hätte
must.en: Show how little effort it means for her team

must.de: eine Kurzfassung für den Geschäftsführer anbieten
must.en: Offer a short summary for the managing director

must.de: einen konkreten nächsten Schritt nach dem Jahresabschluss vorschlagen
must.en: Suggest a concrete next step after year-end

reply:
Hi Laura,

Thanks for your quick reply, and good luck with the year-end closing. I completely understand that a new project is the last thing your team needs right now.

I've attached a one-page overview with our prices and a short example from a logistics company of your size. It shows how little time the setup takes for the accounting team: about two hours of workshops in total. If it helps, I can also prepare a short summary for your managing director.

Would it make sense to talk again in late February?

Best regards

subject: Cloud archive?
body:
Hello,

My IT partner told me we should move our archive to the cloud. To be honest, I don't really understand what we would gain. We have a server in the basement, and it has worked for twelve years. Can you explain in simple words why we should spend money on this?

Regards,
Peter Wolf

hidden.de: Er fühlt sich von Technik überfordert und will nicht dumm dastehen. Außerdem hängt er am Bewährten.
hidden.en: He feels overwhelmed by the technology and does not want to look foolish. He is also attached to what has always worked.

must.de: in einfachen Worten ohne Fachbegriffe antworten
must.en: Answer in plain words without technical terms

must.de: den Nutzen für seinen Betrieb nennen, nicht Produktmerkmale
must.en: Name the benefit for his business, not product features
Respect the current system

reply:
Hello Mr. Wolf,

Thanks for asking so directly. It's a fair question, and your server has clearly done its job well.

In a nutshell, a cloud archive means your documents are stored safely in a professional data center instead of your basement. What that means for you: no worries about hardware failures or backups, and your team can find any invoice or drawing in seconds, even from the construction site.

If you like, I can show you in 20 minutes what that would look like with your own documents. Would next Thursday work for you?

Best regards

subject: Re: Your offer
body:
Hello,

Thank you for the offer. We have reviewed it with our controller. Frankly, the annual license fee is higher than we expected, and the savings you mention seem optimistic. Our current provider has offered to extend our contract at the same price. Please let me know if there is anything you can do.

Kind regards,
Dr. Sabine Keller

hidden.de: Sie glaubt die Einsparungen nicht und nutzt das Angebot des Altanbieters als Druckmittel. Sie will verhandeln, nicht absagen.
hidden.en: She does not believe the savings and uses the old provider’s offer as leverage. She wants to negotiate, not say no.

must.de: die Zweifel an den Einsparungen ernst nehmen
must.en: Take her doubts about the savings seriously

must.de: die Einsparungen mit ihren eigenen Zahlen belegen
must.en: Back up the savings with her own numbers

must.de: nicht sofort Rabatt geben, sondern einen Weg anbieten
must.en: Do not give a discount right away, but offer a way forward

reply:
Dear Dr. Keller,

Thank you for reviewing our offer so carefully. I understand it may seem high at first glance, and I appreciate that you told me openly.

You are right to question the savings. Instead of relying on our estimates, I suggest a four-week pilot with your accounts payable team. We would measure the time per invoice before and after, so you can calculate the total cost of ownership with your own data.

If the numbers don't convince you, you can simply extend your current contract. Would a short call on Tuesday or Wednesday work to discuss the pilot?

Kind regards

subject: Security questionnaire
body:
Hi,

Before we continue, I need your answers to the attached security questionnaire (48 questions). I also need your ISO certificate and the list of all subcontractors. To be clear: our board has had bad experiences with cloud providers in the past. I will not recommend anything that I cannot fully explain to them.

Markus Brandt

hidden.de: Er trägt das Risiko gegenüber der Geschäftsführung und hat Angst, sich zu blamieren. Er braucht Belege, die er weitergeben kann.
hidden.en: He carries the risk in front of the board and is afraid of being embarrassed. He needs evidence he can pass on.

must.en: Acknowledge his caution

must.de: konkrete Unterlagen und einen Termin nennen
must.en: Name concrete documents and a date

must.de: nichts versprechen, was nicht sicher ist
must.en: Do not promise anything that is not certain

must.de: Hilfe für seine Präsentation vor der Geschäftsführung anbieten
must.en: Offer help for his presentation to the board

reply:
Hi Mr. Brandt,

Thank you for the questionnaire. Given your board's experience, it makes complete sense to check everything carefully.

Our security officer will complete the questionnaire by next Friday. I've already attached our ISO 27001 certificate and the list of subcontractors. For three of the questions, about penetration tests, we will need to double-check the latest results, so I will send those answers separately rather than guess.

If it helps, we can also join a short call with your board to answer their questions directly. Just let me know.

Best regards

subject: E-invoicing – do we really need to act now?
body:
Hello,

My tax advisor keeps talking about e-invoicing. As far as I understand, we only have to be able to receive e-invoices, and our accounting software can already open PDF files. So I don't see why we should start a project now. Or am I missing something?

Best,
Thomas Richter

hidden.de: Er hofft, dass er nichts tun muss, und ist unsicher, ob er die Regeln richtig verstanden hat. Er will nicht belehrt werden.
hidden.en: He hopes he does not have to do anything and is unsure whether he understood the rules. He does not want to be lectured.

must.en: Answer his question respectfully

must.de: den Unterschied zwischen PDF und E-Rechnung einfach erklären
must.en: Explain the difference between a PDF and an e-invoice simply
Name the upcoming deadlines
Suggest a small first step

reply:
Hello Mr. Richter,

That's a very good question, and many managing directors are asking the same thing.

A PDF is not an e-invoice in the legal sense. An e-invoice is a structured file, like XRechnung or ZUGFeRD, that software can read automatically. Receiving them has been mandatory since January 2025, and the obligation to send them is being phased in from 2027.

You don't need a big project today. I'd suggest a 30-minute check of your current software with your tax advisor, so you know exactly what's missing. Would that be helpful?

Best regards

role: Assistant to the CEO, Weber Group
subject: Presentation on Thursday
body:
Dear all,

Just a quick note for Thursday: Mr. Weber has only 20 minutes instead of the planned 45, because of an urgent board call. He also asked me to tell you that he is not interested in technical details. He wants to know one thing: what does it cost, and what does it bring?

Best regards,
Claudia Weber

hidden.de: Der Chef hat wenig Zeit und wenig Geduld. Wer jetzt nicht auf den Punkt kommt, verliert ihn.
hidden.en: The boss has little time and little patience. If you do not get to the point, you will lose him.

must.en: Confirm the change positively

must.de: zeigen, dass die Präsentation angepasst wird
must.en: Show that the presentation will be adjusted

must.de: Kosten und Nutzen als Kern ankündigen
must.en: Announce costs and benefits as the core

reply:
Dear Ms. Weber,

Thank you for letting me know, and please tell Mr. Weber that 20 minutes is perfectly fine.

I'll adjust the presentation to three slides: the investment, the savings, and the timeline. What really matters for him is the business case, so I'll skip the technical part completely. We'll leave at least five minutes for his questions.

If he would like to see the numbers in advance, I'm happy to send a one-page summary tomorrow.

Best regards

subject: Final offer
body:
Hello,

We have now received three offers. Yours is the most expensive. If you can match the lowest offer, we are ready to sign by the end of the month. Otherwise, we will have to go with another provider. I need your answer by Wednesday.

Regards,
Julia Roth

hidden.de: Sie will die Firma eigentlich (sonst würde sie nicht schreiben), braucht aber einen Erfolg für den Einkauf. Die Frist ist ein Druckmittel.
hidden.en: She actually wants your company (otherwise she would not write), but she needs a win for procurement. The deadline is a pressure tactic.

must.en: Stay calm and polite
Do not simply lower the price

must.de: ein Zugeständnis nur gegen eine Gegenleistung anbieten
must.en: Offer a concession only in exchange for something
Confirm the deadline

reply:
Hello Ms. Roth,

Thank you for your openness, and I'm glad to hear you're ready to move forward. Here is my answer ahead of your Wednesday deadline.

Matching the lowest offer isn't something I can agree to, because our price includes hosting, updates, and support that other offers often charge separately. However, there is a way we could move closer: if you could commit to three years, we could reduce the price per user by eight percent.

Would it help to compare the offers line by line in a short call on Tuesday?

Best regards

subject: Re: Partnership idea
body:
Hi,

Thanks for your email. Sounds quite interesting. We're rather busy at the moment, but it might be worth a chat at some point. Perhaps after the summer?

Cheers,
James

hidden.de: Britisches Understatement: „quite interesting“ und „might be worth a chat“ heißen eher „vielleicht, aber keine Priorität“. Ohne klaren Anlass passiert nichts.
hidden.en: British understatement: "quite interesting" and "might be worth a chat" mean "maybe, but not a priority". Without a clear reason, nothing will happen.

must.de: die Antwort richtig einordnen und keinen Druck machen
must.en: Read the answer correctly and do not push
Offer a small, concrete reason to talk

must.de: einen Termin nach dem Sommer festhalten
must.en: Secure a date after the summer

reply:
Hi James,

Thanks for getting back to me, and I completely understand that summer is a busy time.

To make it easy, I'll send you a two-page overview of our partner program in the meantime, including the commission model and what we do for enablement and co-marketing. You can look at it whenever it suits you.

Would you be open to a quick call in the first week of September? I'm happy to work around your schedule.

Best regards

subject: Migration still not finished!!
body:
Hello,

This is the second time I've had to write to you. The migration was supposed to be finished on September 15. It is now September 28, and my team still can't find half of the old contracts. I have to explain this to our CEO tomorrow morning. What exactly is going on?

Frank Schulz

hidden.de: Er steht selbst unter Druck vor seinem Chef und braucht morgen früh eine klare, erklärbare Antwort.
hidden.en: He is under pressure from his own boss and needs a clear answer he can explain tomorrow morning.

must.en: Apologize clearly, without excuses
Name the cause and the actions

must.de: ein festes Datum und regelmäßige Updates zusagen
must.en: Commit to a fixed date and regular updates

must.de: Hilfe für das Gespräch mit dem Chef anbieten
must.en: Offer help for the conversation with his CEO

reply:
Hello Mr. Schulz,

I owe you an apology. You should not have had to write twice, and I understand how difficult this is for you.

We've identified the root cause: about 80,000 older files use a format our import tool did not recognize. Here's what we're doing about it: two additional engineers are working on the remaining files, and we expect everything to be complete by October 2. Until then, all contracts are still available in the old system.

I'll send you a one-page summary tonight that you can share with your CEO. I'll keep you posted every Friday.

Best regards

subject: Monday meeting
body:
Hi,

Quick question about Monday: could we skip the pipeline review this week? Most of us are preparing year-end offers, and to be honest, the meeting usually runs way over time and doesn't really help us. Maybe we could just update the CRM instead?

Thanks,
Tobias

hidden.de: Das Meeting wird als Zeitverschwendung empfunden. Eigentlich geht es darum, dass es zu lang und zu wenig nützlich ist.
hidden.en: The team sees the meeting as a waste of time. The real issue is that it is too long and not useful enough.

must.en: Take the criticism seriously

must.de: erklären, warum das Meeting wichtig ist
must.en: Explain why the meeting matters
Suggest a concrete improvement

reply:
Hi Tobias,

Thanks for being honest. You're right, it runs too long, especially at this time of year.

I'd still like to meet, because the forecast for the quarter depends on the next four weeks. But let's make it shorter: 30 minutes, one sentence per deal, and we'll take any longer discussions offline. If the CRM is up to date by Friday, we can go even faster.

Who's going to own the agenda this week? Maybe you'd like to try it?

Best

subject: Contract renewal
body:
Hi,

Our contract ends on October 31. I assume it will just renew automatically? By the way, our new CFO has asked all departments to review their software costs, so I may need to justify the license fee internally.

Best regards,
Anna

hidden.de: Die Verlängerung ist in Gefahr: Der neue CFO prüft Kosten, und Anna braucht Argumente, um den Vertrag intern zu verteidigen.
hidden.en: The renewal is at risk: the new CFO is reviewing costs, and Anna needs arguments to defend the contract internally.

must.en: Confirm the renewal
Recognize the hidden risk
Offer evidence of the benefit

must.de: Unterstützung für das interne Gespräch anbieten
must.en: Offer support for the internal conversation

reply:
Hi Anna,

Yes, the contract renews automatically on November 1, so there's nothing you need to do.

Since your new CFO is reviewing costs, I was wondering if a short summary of your results would help. Over the past year, your team has processed more than 30,000 invoices in the system, and the approval time has dropped from nine days to three. I'd be happy to put this on one page for you.

If it's useful, I could also join a short meeting with your CFO. No pressure at all, of course.

Best regards

subject: Great meeting you
body:
Hi,

Great meeting you at the trade show last week. I passed your brochure on to my boss, but honestly, we're not looking at new software until next year. Let's stay in touch though.

Best,
Kevin

hidden.de: Höfliche Absage für jetzt. Kevin ist nicht der Entscheider, aber offen für Kontakt.
hidden.en: A polite no for now. Kevin is not the decision maker, but he is open to staying in contact.

must.en: Reply in a relaxed, friendly tone
Keep in touch without pushing
Offer something useful

reply:
Hi Kevin,

Great connecting with you at the show, and thanks for passing the brochure on.

Totally understood about the timing. In the meantime, I thought you might find this short case study interesting. It's from a freight company that cut its paperwork in half, and it takes about three minutes to read.

I'll check in again early next year. Let's stay in touch, and good luck with the busy season!

Best

subject: Your stay last week
body:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for staying with us. We are sorry to hear that your room was not as expected on your first night. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer you a 10% discount on your next stay.

Kind regards,
Guest Relations

hidden.de: Das Hotel will die Sache mit einem Gutschein für die Zukunft erledigen, ohne das eigentliche Problem (falsches Zimmer, bezahlter Preis) zu lösen.
hidden.en: The hotel wants to settle the matter with a voucher for the future without solving the real problem (the wrong room and the price paid).

must.en: Stay polite but firm
Describe the problem precisely
Ask for a concrete solution

reply:
Dear Guest Relations team,

Thank you for your reply. I appreciate the offer, but I'm afraid a discount on a future stay doesn't really solve the problem.

I had booked and paid for a quiet room with a desk, which I needed for work. On the first night, I was given a small room next to the elevator. That's not what I booked. I'd appreciate it if you could refund the difference for that night instead.

I'd like to get this straightened out, and I'm sure we can find a fair solution.

Kind regards

subject: Customer story for the newsletter
body:
Hi,

For the next newsletter, I'd love a short customer story from you, about 150 words. Something personal would be great: how the project started, what went wrong, and how it ended. Could you send me something by Friday?

Thanks!
Sarah

hidden.de: Sarah will keine Faktenliste, sondern eine Geschichte mit Wendepunkt. Die Zeit ist knapp.
hidden.en: Sarah does not want a list of facts but a story with a turning point. Time is short.

must.en: Agree and confirm the deadline

must.de: eine kurze Geschichte mit Anfang, Wendepunkt und Ende liefern oder skizzieren
must.en: Deliver or outline a short story with a beginning, a turning point, and an end

reply:
Hi Sarah,

Happy to help, and Friday works. Here's a first draft:

Last spring, a food company called us because their auditor had found 400 missing invoices. So there I was, in a basement full of boxes, wondering where to start. It turned out that most invoices had simply been filed under the wrong supplier. Long story short, we scanned everything in two weeks, and the system now finds any invoice in seconds. In the end, the auditor was the happiest person in the room.

Let me know if you'd like any changes.

Best

subject: That article about AI
body:
Hey,

Did you read the article I sent you? I really think we should tell our customers that our AI search will replace their archive staff. It's the strongest argument we have. Management loves it. What do you think?

Mark

hidden.de: Mark will Zustimmung. Die Aussage ist übertrieben und könnte Kunden (und Betriebsräte) abschrecken.
hidden.en: Mark wants agreement. The claim is exaggerated and could scare off customers (and works councils).

must.en: Acknowledge his point
Disagree without attacking him
Suggest a better way to say it

reply:
Hey Mark,

Yes, I read it, thanks. I see where you're coming from, but I think it's a bit more nuanced than that. The AI search is a strong argument, and management is right to push it.

However, if we tell customers it will replace their staff, the works council could well stop the project before it even starts. I'd argue that it's better to say the AI takes over the boring searching, so people can focus on the work that needs their judgment.

Shall we try both versions with a customer next week and see which works better? Time will tell.

Best

subject: Re: Heating
body:
Hello,

I have received your message. The plumber is very busy right now. He can come in about three weeks. Until then, please use an electric heater.

Regards,
J. Novak

hidden.de: Der Vermieter schiebt das Problem auf und ignoriert das Leck. Drei Wochen ohne Heizung im Herbst sind nicht akzeptabel.
hidden.en: The landlord is putting the problem off and ignores the leak. Three weeks without heating in the fall is not acceptable.

must.en: Stay polite but disagree clearly

must.de: auf das Leck und mögliche Schäden hinweisen
must.en: Point out the leak and possible damage
Ask for a faster solution
Ask about the options

reply:
Hello Mr. Novak,

Thank you for your quick reply. I understand that the plumber is busy, but I'm afraid three weeks is too long.

Besides the heating, there is still a small leak at the pipe, and the water could damage the wooden floor. Could you take a look at it yourself this week, or ask another company? Would it be possible to at least fix the leak before the weekend?

If the repair takes longer, what are my options? I would also like to know who pays for the electricity for the heater.

Best regards
